'''April 2001 Frankenmuth tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at Wickson Memorial Library, Frankenmuth, Michigan on 7 April 2001. [[Andrew Ehret]] won it. It is known from Andrew Ehret's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2033">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-07-frankenmuth-michigan-on-4-8-2001d2033/ frankenmuth-michigan-on-4-8-2001], DeckTech (Andrew "Gwaihir" Ehret, 7 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-07-frankenmuth-michigan-on-4-8-2001d2033/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Wickson Memorial Library, Frankenmuth, Michigan
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 17
* '''Winner:''' [[Andrew Ehret]]
